name: Access Revoke Request Reviewer
description: Notifies a user that they have an access revoke request to review.
subject: New access revoke request for ${requestedForIdentityName} ready for review
body:
Access revoke request ready for review

Dear ${user.name},

$requesterName has submitted a request to revoke the $requestedObjectName $requestedObjectType from $requestedForIdentityName. Your review is needed before this change can proceed.

Request details

  • Access item: $requestedObjectName ($requestedObjectType)
  • Identity: $requestedForIdentityName
#if($requesterComments)

$requesterName provided the following reason for revocation:
"$requesterComments"

#end

If this request is approved, $requestedForIdentityName will lose the $requestedObjectName $requestedObjectType#if($requestedObjectType == "Role" || $requestedObjectType == "AccessProfile") and all associated entitlements #if($removeDate)on $removeDate#end.#end

Best regards,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
